presets.label: Surgical (default)
presets.description: Hides intracranial, spinal, cardiac, pulmonary segmental, and abdominal visceral organ-branch vessels so reconstructive trunk & limb pedicles stand out.

presets.label: Upper limb
presets.description: Isolates axillary, brachial, radial, ulnar, interosseous, palmar, digital, cephalic, and basilic upper-extremity vessels.

presets.label: Lower limb
presets.description: Isolates iliac, femoral, popliteal, tibial, fibular, dorsalis pedis, plantar, genicular, saphenous, and perforating lower-extremity vessels.

presets.label: Trunk wall and shoulder girdle
presets.description: Isolates epigastric, internal/lateral thoracic, intercostal, thoracodorsal, scapular, thoracoacromial, cervical, subclavian, carotid, and jugular vessels.

presets.label: All vessels
presets.description: Displays every loaded artery and vein mesh without decluttering.
